headline: Almaty Thursday: Tsitsipas beats Kukushkin, Mannarino stuns Rublev
whyCareReason: Tsitsipas ended Kukushkin's 20-year career 6-1, 6-2. Mannarino upset 4th seed Rublev in three sets.
teaser: Tsitsipas d. Kukushkin 6-1, 6-2 in Kukushkin's farewell match. Mannarino d. Rublev 6-4, 3-6, 6-3. Duckworth reaches QF.
story: The round of 16 at the Almaty Open delivered major milestones and upsets on Thursday, 22 October. Stefanos Tsitsipas ended the singles career of 38-year-old Kazakh stalwart Mikhail Kukushkin with a 6-1, 6-2 victory on center court, concluding Kukushkin's nearly two-decade professional journey in front of an emotional home crowd. In another standout result, veteran Adrian Mannarino upset fourth seed Andrey Rublev 6-4, 3-6, 6-3 with surgical counter-punching. Australian James Duckworth also advanced to the quarterfinals by defeating second seed Luciano Darderi 7-5, 7-6(9), while Mattia Bellucci ousted sixth seed Tomas Martin Etcheverry 7-6(7), 2-6, 6-4.
stakes: Quarterfinal matchups are locked in Almaty. Tsitsipas and Mannarino progress into the final eight as high seeds fall.
rivalryAngle: Tsitsipas handles the emotional atmosphere of a home favorite's farewell to secure his quarterfinal spot.
funFacts: Tsitsipas defeated Kukushkin 6-1, 6-2 in Kukushkin's final career singles match.
Mannarino upset fourth seed Andrey Rublev 6-4, 3-6, 6-3.
